_meta.title: Format & integrity invariants
_meta.description: Language-neutral port of Bahi's sample-data/test_khata.py. Every invariant is a structural or accounting property any conforming .khata must satisfy; checked directly against the file, independent of any engine. Runner: harness/format_suite.py. Case metadata (home_state, expected identity, capability flags) comes from corpus/manifest.json.

kinds.sql-empty: Query MUST return zero rows (it selects violations).
kinds.sql-two-scalars-rel: Query returns one row (a,b); if a>0 then abs(a-b)/abs(a) MUST be <= `tolRel`.
kinds.native: Handled in the runner by `native` name (structural checks over zip/manifest/chain).

placeholders.{{home_state}}: The case's home_state (ISO 3166-2:IN code) from corpus/manifest.json.

invariants.desc: File exists and is not suspiciously small.
Zip contains the two mandatory members.
PRAGMA integrity_check returns 'ok'.
manifest.schemaVersion and meta.schemaVersion both equal 12.
manifest.khataFormatVersion == '1.0'.
manifest.integrity.booksHash == sha256(books.sqlite bytes).
manifest.integrity.auditHead == hash of the last audit_log row.
manifest.company {gstin,name,state} match the case's expected identity.

invariants.sql: SELECT SUM(debit)-SUM(credit) FROM entry_lines
invariants.desc: Grand total of all entry_lines ties to zero (Dr = Cr).

invariants.sql: SELECT entry_id FROM entry_lines GROUP BY entry_id HAVING SUM(debit)-SUM(credit) <> 0
invariants.desc: Every individual entry is balanced.

invariants.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM entry_lines el JOIN accounts a ON a.id=el.account_id WHERE a.type='asset'
invariants.desc: There are asset postings.

invariants.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM entry_lines el JOIN accounts a ON a.id=el.account_id WHERE a.type='income'
invariants.desc: There are income postings.

invariants.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM entry_lines el JOIN accounts a ON a.id=el.account_id WHERE a.type='liability'
invariants.desc: There are liability postings.

invariants.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_log
invariants.desc: Audit chain is not suspiciously short (> 100 rows).
Structural hash-walk: genesis prev_hash is 0*64/''/NULL, and every prev_hash equals the previous row's hash. (Full sha256 recomputation is Tier C.)

invariants.sql: SELECT id FROM audit_log WHERE signature IS NULL OR signature=''
invariants.desc: Every audit row carries a signature.

invariants.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_log WHERE origin LIKE '%generator.py%'
invariants.desc: Corpus rows are tagged with the generator origin.

invariants.sql: SELECT id FROM invoices WHERE company_snapshot IS NULL OR company_snapshot=''
invariants.desc: Inv1: every invoice froze company_snapshot.

invariants.sql: SELECT id FROM invoices WHERE customer_snapshot IS NULL OR customer_snapshot=''
invariants.desc: Inv6: every invoice froze customer_snapshot.

invariants.sql: SELECT id FROM invoices WHERE place_of_supply_name IS NULL OR place_of_supply_name=''
invariants.desc: Inv4: every invoice froze place_of_supply_name.

invariants.sql: SELECT id FROM invoice_lines WHERE (hsn_description IS NULL OR hsn_description='') AND hsn_sac IS NOT NULL AND hsn_sac<>''
invariants.desc: Inv3: lines with an HSN/SAC froze its description.

invariants.sql: SELECT id FROM invoice_lines WHERE rate_id IS NULL OR rate_id=''
invariants.desc: Inv2: every taxable line froze its rate_id.

invariants.sql: SELECT id FROM entry_lines WHERE account_name IS NULL OR account_name=''
invariants.desc: Inv7: every entry line froze its account_name.

invariants.sql: SELECT id FROM payment_allocations WHERE invoice_number_snapshot IS NULL OR invoice_number_snapshot=''
invariants.desc: Every payment allocation froze the invoice number.

invariants.sql: SELECT id FROM invoices WHERE json_extract(company_snapshot,'$.gstin') IS NULL OR length(json_extract(company_snapshot,'$.gstin'))<>15
invariants.desc: Every company_snapshot is valid JSON with a 15-char GSTIN.

invariants.sql: SELECT invoice_number FROM invoices WHERE (subtotal+cgst+sgst+igst+cess+round_off)-total <> 0
invariants.desc: Invoice total equals the sum of its components.

invariants.sql: SELECT i.invoice_number FROM invoices i LEFT JOIN invoice_lines il ON il.invoice_id=i.id GROUP BY i.id HAVING i.subtotal-COALESCE(SUM(il.taxable),0) <> 0
invariants.desc: Invoice lines' taxable values sum to the header subtotal.

invariants.sql: SELECT invoice_number FROM invoices WHERE is_export=0 AND is_sez=0 AND ( (place_of_supply='{{home_state}}' AND igst>0) OR (place_of_supply<>'{{home_state}}' AND (cgst+sgst)>0) )
invariants.desc: GST routing: intra-state has CGST+SGST (no IGST); inter-state has IGST only.

invariants.sql: SELECT id FROM invoice_lines WHERE rate_id IS NULL OR rate_id=''
invariants.desc: Every invoice line resolves to a rate_id.

invariants.sql: SELECT p.id FROM payments p LEFT JOIN payment_allocations pa ON pa.payment_id=p.id GROUP BY p.id HAVING COALESCE(SUM(pa.amount),0) > p.amount
invariants.desc: Allocations never exceed the payment amount.

invariants.sql: SELECT i.id FROM invoices i LEFT JOIN payment_allocations pa ON pa.invoice_id=i.id GROUP BY i.id HAVING COALESCE(SUM(pa.amount),0) - i.total > 0
invariants.desc: An invoice is never over-paid (outstanding never goes negative).

invariants.sql: SELECT id FROM payments WHERE ledger_entry_id IS NULL
invariants.desc: Every payment posted a ledger entry.

invariants.sql: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(cgst) FROM invoices),0)-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(cgst) FROM invoice_lines),0)
invariants.desc: CGST header total ties to line total.

invariants.sql: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(sgst) FROM invoices),0)-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(sgst) FROM invoice_lines),0)
invariants.desc: SGST header total ties to line total.

invariants.sql: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(igst) FROM invoices),0)-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(igst) FROM invoice_lines),0)
invariants.desc: IGST header total ties to line total.

invariants.sql: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(cgst+sgst+igst+cess) FROM invoices),0) AS a, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(el.credit-el.debit) FROM entry_lines el JOIN accounts a ON a.id=el.account_id WHERE a.name LIKE '%GST%Output%' OR a.name LIKE '%CGST%Output%' OR a.name LIKE '%SGST%Output%' OR a.name LIKE '%IGST%Output%'),0) AS b
invariants.desc: Output GST in the ledger is within 10% of invoice GST (credit notes reverse some).

invariants.sql: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(tds_amount) FROM tds_deductions),0)-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(el.credit-el.debit) FROM entry_lines el JOIN accounts a ON a.id=el.account_id WHERE a.name LIKE '%TDS Payable%'),0)
invariants.desc: TDS deducted ties to the TDS Payable ledger credit.

invariants.sql: SELECT id FROM tds_deductions WHERE ledger_entry_id IS NULL
invariants.desc: Every TDS deduction posted a ledger entry.

invariants.sql: SELECT item_id FROM stock_movements GROUP BY item_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN movement_type='in' THEN qty ELSE -qty END) < 0
invariants.desc: Per-item on-hand never goes negative.

invariants.sql: SELECT id FROM stock_movements WHERE movement_type='in' AND ABS(value-qty*rate) > 50
invariants.desc: Inward stock value equals qty*rate (outward uses WAC/FIFO, excluded).

invariants.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_movements
invariants.desc: A services-only company has no stock movements.

invariants.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items WHERE hsn_sac LIKE '30%' OR hsn_sac LIKE '90%' OR hsn_sac LIKE '38%'
invariants.desc: Pharma has goods (HSN) items.

invariants.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items WHERE hsn_sac LIKE '99%'
invariants.desc: Pharma has service (SAC) items.

invariants.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM credit_notes
invariants.desc: Pharma has credit notes.

invariants.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM advances
invariants.desc: Pharma has at least one advance.

invariants.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items WHERE hsn_sac LIKE '99%'
invariants.desc: A goods-only manufacturer has zero SAC (service) items.

invariants.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_movements
invariants.desc: Manufacturing has heavy inventory movement.

invariants.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchases
invariants.desc: A pure-services consultancy has zero purchases.

invariants.sql: SELECT id FROM items WHERE hsn_sac IS NULL OR hsn_sac NOT LIKE '99%'
invariants.desc: Every consulting item is a SAC service code.

invariants.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tds_deductions
invariants.desc: All three companies have TDS deductions.

invariants.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN MIN(invoice_date) < '2025-01-01' AND MAX(invoice_date) > '2025-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM invoices
invariants.desc: Invoice data spans at least two fiscal years.
